claims.claim: The charger provides 65W total output with single USB-C port output up to 65W.
Lightning devices require a USB-C to Lightning cable and USB-C devices require a USB-C to USB-C cable; cables are sold separately.
The charger is listed by Anker as a GaN II PPS charger with PowerIQ 3.0 and PowerIQ 2.0.
Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W) is model A2667.
Anker states the charger supports Samsung S22 Ultra Super Fast Charging but not 45W Super Fast Charging 2.0.
The charger has two USB-C ports and one USB-A port.

evidence.excerpt: Anker describes the product as a GaN II PPS 3-port 65W foldable wall charger and notes cable requirements plus the Samsung S22 Ultra Super Fast Charging limitation.
evidence.title: Introduction to Anker 735 Charger (Nano II 65W)

evidence.excerpt: Ports: 3. Input: 100~240V~ 1.8A, 50-60Hz. Output includes USB-C 1 65W max, USB-C 2 65W max, USB-A 22.5W max, and three-port allocation of 40W, 12W, and 12W. Charging technology includes PPS, PIQ 3.0, PIQ 2.0, and GAN II.

skus.limitations: Samsung S22 Ultra supports Super Fast Charging with this charger, but not 45W Super Fast Charging 2.0.; Charging speed depends on device input limits and cable capability.; Cables are sold separately.
skus.not_for: Devices that require more than 65W sustained input; Buyers who need Samsung 45W Super Fast Charging 2.0 support
